findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "dmd_purchase" is 880 chars, far longer than this server's median (160). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agenticsuperhighway" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dmd_list_in_directory · Private data: dmd_list_supported_payment_options, dmd_prove_wallet_control, dmd_register_did, dmd_search_directory, dmd_purchase · Public sink: dmd_submit_payment_reference.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dmd_list_in_directory · Private data: dmd_list_supported_payment_options, dmd_prove_wallet_control, dmd_register_did, dmd_search_directory, dmd_purchase · Public sink: dmd_submit_payment_reference

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
